scope: Saved evaluation data arithmetic only. No project modules imported and no neural, environment, runner, scoring, fitting, bootstrap, trajectory replay or analysis executable invoked.

formulas.cost: math.fsum of all raw cost components at epochs0..63; stored cost/reward used only for reconciliation
formulas.outcomes: unique terminal lost/delivered patient IDs at epoch63, checked against cumulative counts, monotone terminal sets and newly-lost ID increments
formulas.cohort: same exact patient-ID set plus immutable enrollment_epoch and collection_site metadata across all three roles per block-condition-replicate
formulas.expected_seed: 62820000+1000*block+100*condition+replicate; verified against current numeric config metadata
formulas.percent_savings: mean of paired-world 100*(comparator_cost-trained_cost)/comparator_cost; not percent of aggregate means
formulas.aggregation: 12 equally weighted worlds per condition; 4 per block-condition; 3 independently trained blocks
formulas.action_window: epochs0..47 for requested/committed hours and changed boundaries; applied hours summed over0..63 including delayed tail
formulas.changed_boundary: max sitewise absolute executed-hours difference exceeds1e-6 at a control epoch
formulas.trained_contract: each requested/executed site within[0.5,3.5]; fsum within1e-12 of8 and neither fsum nor builtin sum greater than8
formulas.native_raw_aggregate: SHA256 over sorted UTF-8 relative_path + NUL + compressed_file_sha256 + newline

action_contract.external_baseline_note: ID-MPC retains its existing variable-total capped action set; restricted[0.5,3.5]/exact8 is not imposed on it.

reconciliation.bootstrap: Reported interval sign only; no bootstrap recomputation.

limitations: Independent saved-data arithmetic is not an independent experimental replication.
Only three independently trained blocks, with four paired worlds per block-condition.
These are simulated lost/delivered states, not observed clinical outcomes; fixed resource totals do not establish safety.
Trained-versus-uniform measures the final trained policy relative to its same-start allocation within this restricted fixed-total family.
ID-MPC is an external performance comparator with a different action set, not an isolated objective or action-map ablation.
No causal comparison against historical studies or effect of changing the action map is identified by this run.
No deployment-online adaptation or isolated graph contribution is established.
Runtime/process/locks/archive and older history were not audited; no source/result edits.

interpretation.conclusion: All three prespecified primary criteria are false; this pilot does not establish patient-preserving training improvement over uniform same-start allocation.
interpretation.component_attribution: Persistent trained-minus-uniform: bioreactor_shortage +456651.8666666672, patient_loss +208333.33333333334, expiry +120000; partly offset by reagent_purchase -77318.99371558412 and reagent_shortage -36043.549400770346. This is ledger attribution, not a causal mechanism.
interpretation.comparator_scope: Fast-fluctuation pooled outcomes favor trained versus external ID-MPC, but not versus uniform. ID-MPC uses variable total hours and a broader action set, so that contrast does not isolate training or action-map effects.
interpretation.uncertainty: The reported persistent savings and loss intervals both cross zero; an unfavorable sample mean is not established clinical harm or a safety conclusion.
interpretation.historical_scope: No comparison with old results was recomputed; differences between historical packages cannot identify a causal effect of the new action map.
